newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bufete Industrial wins two Chile contracts.
newsitem.headline: Bufete Industrial wins two Chile contracts.

text.p: Bufete Industrial, through its Chilean subsidiary Ovalle Moore, has won two contracts for construction work in Chile, Bufete said Monday.

Bufete said Ovalle Moore won "a project for Mistubishi Heavy Industries y Mitsubishi Corp. The project includes the construction and electromechanical installation of a sulphuric acid plant for Corporacion del Cobre (Codelco)."

Building work on the plant is already in progress at Codelco's "El Teniente" site and is due to be completed in June 1998. The value of the contract was not disclosed but a company spokesman told Reuters it was denominated in dollars.
The other contract awarded to Ovalle Moore is the second phase of installing a bottle-making furnace for Cristalerias Chile.
